Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner accepted and built on the incorrect premise that Toongabbie Creek flows into the Hawkesbury River without verification, directing research toward Hawkesbury’s outflow. In reality, Toongabbie Creek flows into the Parramatta River, which flows into Port Jackson (Sydney Harbour). This misidentification led to the wrong final answer (Tasman Sea via Broken Bay) instead of Port Jackson.
